definitions: A unit of differential cross-section, commonly used in nuclear and particle physics, representing an area per unit solid angle. It is equal to 10^-3 barn per steradian, or 10^-32 square meters per steradian.
examples: The differential cross-section was measured in millibarn per steradian.
Data is often presented in millibarn per steradian.
The plot shows the yield in millibarn per steradian.
